title: Erasing one unary symbol
statement: For all natural numbers $j$ and $n$, updating the state window with $j$ consumed symbols and $n+1$ remaining symbols by writing a blank in cell $j+1$ gives the state window with $j+1$ consumed symbols and $n$ remaining symbols.
replaced:
Erasing the cell at position $j + 1$ of a state window with $j$ erased and
$n + 1$ remaining unary cells (writing the blank there) yields exactly the
state window with $j + 1$ erased and $n$ remaining cells.
